column1: # Rows db.device.* (line RG item T6a fix 3, 2026-11-22): psiblast's report on a device that fails (`device: MODE`, db_search_fixtures.py `run_on_device`); the frozen bytes are the NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 exit status, stderr and what reached the device. They place `Search has CONVERGED!` (written between two NcbiEndl outside the tabular block), a failed standard error, and a closed pipe (LOSAT only, `ncbi-near` of the full device).
